caveats.message: A statistical fingerprint describes measurements, not a style proof or a player quality verdict.
Nearest-neighbour similarity is an identity test, not a recruitment recommendation.
Same-season comparisons keep the same club and fixture context, which is a known confound.
Display percentiles are within-role; the retrieval model still uses global z-scores.
Uncertainty intervals reflect a resampling simulation and are reported with the monograph caveats.

uncertainty.warning: Fixture bootstrap resolved only 4 valid resamples, below the stated minimum; no interval is reported.
